title: TokenizeRequest
description: The body of POST /tokenize. Each block is tokenized on its own, so no token crosses a block. Lengths count code points. A body over 8 MiB, or blocks holding more than 500,000 characters in all, answers 413. Anything else this schema rejects answers 422.

blocks.description: The blocks to tokenize. Ids must be unique within a request.

id.description: The caller's name for the block, returned with its tokens.
